tools.name: upload_url
tools.description: Upload an image to BeeIMG by fetching it from a remote URL. Returns the hosted image URL, thumbnail, view page, and delete URL.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload an image file to BeeIMG from base64 or a data URI. Returns the hosted image URL, thumbnail, view page, and delete URL.

tools.name: delete_image
tools.description: Delete an image hosted on BeeIMG using its image ID, your API key, and the delete key returned at upload time. Returns OK or ERROR.

tools.name: beeimg_premium_info
tools.description: Returns the current BeeIMG free-plan limits, premium perks, and upgrade links. Call this when an upload fails with a rate limit, storage limit, or file-too-large error to advise the user about upgrading.

tools.name: list_albums
tools.description: List all albums owned by the authenticated user. Returns album IDs, titles, privacy, and view counts. Use album IDs with upload_url/upload_file albumid parameter.

tools.name: create_album
tools.description: Create a new album. Returns the album ID to use with upload_url/upload_file albumid parameter.

tools.name: get_album
tools.description: Get album details, folders, and images. Use folder IDs from the folders array with upload_url/upload_file albumid parameter.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a sub-folder in an album. Returns the folder ID (9 chars) to use with upload_url/upload_file albumid parameter.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: upload_url, upload_file · Private data: upload_file, delete_image, beeimg_premium_info · Public sink: upload_url, upload_file, delete_image, beeimg_premium_info · Destructive: upload_url, upload_file, delete_image.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: upload_url, upload_file · Private data: upload_file, delete_image, beeimg_premium_info · Public sink: upload_url, upload_file, delete_image, beeimg_premium_info · Destructive: upload_url, upload_file, delete_image

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
